Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 26-Jun-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FOURTH SEMESTER B.TECH. (INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY) DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - JUNE 2024  
  SUBJECT: ICT 2223/ICT_2223 - EMBEDDED SYSTEMS  
  EMBEDDED SYSTEMS [ICT 2223]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                     Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)                Develop an embedded C program to toggle the LED connected to P0.2 for every 500ms. Also,               (5)  
  display the status of a switch connected to P2.12 on the LED connected to P4.2.  
1B)                Write an embedded C program to display a 4 -bit ring counter on a multiplexed seven segment            (3)  
  display. Assume the data lines are connected to P0.15 to P0.8 and the decoder lines are  
  connected to P1.3 to P1.0.  
1C)                Explain the following instructions with an example for each.                                           (2)  
  i) BGE  
  ii) BLS  
2A)                Discuss the different modes available to apply external interrupts? Develop an embedded C              (5)  
  program to turn ON the LED connected to P0.4 whenever the input at P2.10 (EINT0, function 1) is  
  HIGH and turn OFF the LED if the input at P2.10 is LOW.  
2B)                Develop an embedded C program to generate a triangular waveform at DAC output (P0.26 in                (3)  
  function 2) with peak-to-peak voltage of 3.3V.  
2C)                Differentiate between a microcontroller and microprocessor.                                            (2)  
3A)                The analog output of sensor1 is connected to AD0.0(P0.23, Function 1) and the analog output of         (5)  
  sensor2 is connected to AD0.2(P0.25, Function1). Write an embedded C program to configure the  
  ADC in software mode and send the digital equivalent of sensor1 analog output at P1.11 to P0.0 if  
  the switch connected to P2.12 is pressed else send digital equivalent of sensor2 analog output to  
  P0.11 to P0.0.  
3B)                Write an assembly language program to convert an 4-digit BCD number available in the data              (3)  
  memory into hexadecimal and store result in the data memory.  
3C)                Determine the value at Port 0 after the execution of the following lines of code, considering the data (2)  
  in the following SFR's  
  $$FIO0SET= 0xA12C$$  
  $$FIO0MASK= 0x842$$  
  $$FIO0SET=0X0743$$  
4A)                Explain Pre indexing and post indexing with the illustration of below code:                            (5)  
  STR r1,[r0,#4]!  
  STR r1,[r0],#4  
  STRH r1,[r0,#4]  
  Assume Little Endian  
  $$r0=0x20000000,$$  
  $$r1=0x87654321$$  
  Find the memory contents of r0 and r1  
4B)                Develop an embedded program to rotate the stepper motor in 20 steps in the clockwise and anti-         (3)  
  Clock direction.  
  Page 1 of 2

4C)   Discuss the instructions STM and LDM with a suitable code.                                     (2)  
5A)   Discuss the differences between LSL and LSLS.                                                  (5)  
  Assume R0 has 0x0000FF18 and R1 has 0x00000010; what is stored in R0, R1, R2 and R3 along  
  with the flags after the below lines of code  
  Mov R3,#16  
  LSL R2,R0,R3  
  LSLS R0,R1,#8  
5B)   Develop the Embedded C code that continuously scans a 3 x 3 matrix keypad for pressed keys and (3)  
  displays the pressed keys on the LCD screen.  
  
  
5C)   Discuss in detail about the Special Purpose Registers in ARM architecture                      (2)  
  
  
  -----End-----  
  
  
  Page 2 of 2
